column6: 长纤维修复纸与轻薄搭接条把旧帖恢复的意图转成细致接缝，保持洁净而不制造破旧感。

column5: A feedback-mailbox writing ledge: fine pebbled enamel paint, shallow overlapping stationery-edge impressions and one small letterpress-like attention notch. Calm tactile incoming correspondence, no actual mailbox, envelope, feedback count, logo or readable text.
column6: 细砂珐琅与叠放信纸的边缘压痕承接用户来信，一枚浅缺口为需要留意的声音留下位置。

column5: A handheld visualization drafting surface: finely frosted glass texture, broad rounded corner registration grooves, sparse plotted dot impressions and one gently rising shallow data-stroke fragment. No actual phone, UI, numbers, charts, logo or translucent rainbow glare.
column6: 磨砂玻璃上的圆角定位槽、稀疏点痕与浅曲线，回应掌上信息展示的尺度和清晰度。

column5: A photographic scanning-bed liner: matte flax-fiber paper, a restrained pair of open photo-registration corners, subtle parallel feed grooves and a quiet short leading-edge crease. No photographs, frame object, upload arrows, text or recreated screenshot.
column6: 亚麻纤维衬纸、开放对位角与平行走纸槽承接图像上传前的整理，图像内容仍保持独立。

column5: An open ostrich savanna habitat: tall narrow grass seed stems, sparse thornbush leaflets and a few bowed dry blades. A broad low wind sweep leaves the middle open, with no ostrich feathers, cowboy hat, native bird claim, flowers or animal.
column6: 高草穗、稀疏刺灌小叶与弯曲干草贴近鸵鸟步行的高度，用开阔风向承接原标的轻快。

column5: A vegetated subantarctic coastal interpretation for an unspecified penguin: coarse tussock-grass blades, a few small leathery coastal herb leaves and one bent grass seed head. Record this as a plausible broad campaign habitat, not a species claim. No tropical plants, flowers, ice emblem or penguin.
column6: 粗壮丛生草与少量海岸草本小叶构成瞭望处。采用合理的亚南极植被联想，不断言企鹅的具体物种。

column5: A fantasy prop-maker's shield workshop surface: fine clean parchment grain, shallow diagonal leather-lacing channels and restrained hammered-metal edge impressions. A few broad asymmetrical heraldic construction folds only; no coat of arms, shield, weapons, runes, characters or text.
column6: 洁净羊皮纸、斜向皮绳槽与浅锤纹金属压边承接盾牌道具的制作感，不另造徽章或武器主体。

column5: A domestic cat's safe windowsill-garden interpretation: rounded softly serrated catmint leaves, a few slender oat-grass blades and delicate branching stems. Compact airy groupings suggest a quiet home. No flowers, yarn loops, paw prints, cartoon coins or cat silhouette.
column6: 柔软猫薄荷叶与细燕麦草在窗边疏散生长，承接家猫的安静日常，不把毛线或爪印再铺满背景。

column5: A coffee tasting work surface: fine uncoated cupping-paper fibers, soft ceramic-glaze micrograin and two broad incomplete translucent ring impressions of unequal size. Only a tiny muted warm brown accent. No cup, coffee beans, botanical illustration, text, wheel graphic or dark stains.
column6: 杯测纸纤维、细瓷釉与两道不完整的浅环痕呼应品饮过程，咖啡杯原标仍是唯一主体。

column5: A crafted gateway instrument's work surface: restrained brushed-brass grain, matte enamel inset seams, a pair of offset vertical guide rebates and one open threshold indentation. Architectural and tactile, no literal door, terminal text, circuit reset route, status light or logo.
column6: 细黄铜拉丝、珐琅嵌缝与错位门框浅槽，承接网关工具的接入关系，保留开门的余地。

column5: A plausible tropical-forest understory for an ocelot: long heliconia-like leaves with clear parallel side veins, small understory fern tips and two curled young leaf edges. Asymmetric leaf overlaps suggest quietly turned pages. No rosettes, big cat, flowers or generic monstera wallpaper.
column6: 长阔蕉叶、林下蕨尖与卷起的新叶边层叠如书页，给豹猫留下通透的热带林下空间。
